title: NCAA opens investigation of Cincinnati over Brendan Sorsby's gambling

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NCAA opens investigation of Cincinnati over Brendan Sorsby's gambling
sources.description: Based on comments made by quarterback Brendan Sorsby's agent, Ron Slavin, regarding Cincinnati's alleged knowledge of Sorsby's gambling habit during his two years with the Bearcats, it was clear that the NCAA should investigate.
